## Highlights

The trash can now be emptied, and notes are a little more compact.

## Changes

- **Delete all…** in the Trash dialog permanently deletes every trashed note and the history kept of it, after a confirmation. Other files in `.trash/` are left alone.
- Notes use tighter spacing: lines, list items, paragraphs and headings sit closer together, so checklists and short notes read less loosely.

## Downloads

One archive for **Linux amd64** holds `coyotenote`, the README, the guide, the license and third-party notices. Check it against `SHA256SUMS`.

[Full changelog: v0.6.0 → v0.6.1](https://github.com/eg36/Coyotenote/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1)
